patch_description: Two targeted improvements: (1) Add zero-cost shape/finiteness validation to the repulsion and SLSQP stages so a single malformed candidate (NaN, wrong size from a failed SLSQP run) can never zero out the whole ~13s pipeline — it falls back to the input instead. Also assert res.x.size == 42 before reshaping, per the crash-pattern recommendation. (2) Enrich the seed set with structurally distinct geometries (dual-ring/anti-prism, two-shell 7+7 configurations, jittered icosahedron) which are known good starting topologies for 14-point packing, giving SLSQP more diverse basins to escape local optima, and validate seed shapes too.
